name: Josh D Ojos Rojos 1g Live Resin Disposable
description:
Lineage: Chem D x OG x Ice Cream Cake (Ricky Bobby)

Terpenes: β-Myrcene, α-Pinene, Limonene

Effects: Euphoric, Stimulating, Happy

Aroma: Sour Cherry, Grape Gas, Citrusy 

This exclusive variety of OG Kush x Chem D x Ice Cream Cake crossed to the popular Studio 54, is appropriately named Red Eyes. The flavor is a complex array of sour cherry and fruity grape gas, with heavy spice and dry hints of lime.
